evidence.artifact: Requires event/urgency/consent matrix and preference routes with a corrected policy/settings artifact.
evidence.transformation: Shopping discounts lose Time Sensitive classification and gain explicit promotional opt-in/withdrawal while respecting Focus.
evidence.verification: Exercises denial/revocation, Focus, opt-out and missing entitlement; marketing breakthrough and guaranteed-delivery claims fail.
evidence.applicability: Correctly qualifies Critical entitlement, user-controlled Time Sensitive behavior and companion-derived Watch settings; native delivery needs runtime evidence.
evidence.handoffs: Notifications handles message/action design and Privacy handles exposure/consent, conditional on the selected concern.
evidence.distinctiveness: Consent provenance and interruption-level honesty distinguish notification management from generic message writing.
